export.needPcb: Open a PCB document first, then export to KiPI.
export.noFile: EasyEDA Pro did not return an ODB++ file.
export.done:
ODB++ exported.

Next:
1. Start KiPI (kipi_launcher.pyw or the kipi command).
2. Click "Open" in KiPI and choose the .tgz file you just saved, or drag the .tgz onto kipi_launcher.pyw.

KiPI reads nets, copper layers, vias, pads and the board outline, then runs DC drop, current density, via current, thermal and PDN impedance analyses.
export.failed: ODB++ export failed. Check that the active document is a PCB and that the extension has file-export permission.
help.body:
KiPI is a standalone power-integrity analyzer for DC voltage drop, current density, via currents, copper temperature and PDN impedance.

In the PCB editor, open the KiPI menu → "Export ODB++ to KiPI…" and choose where to save. Then start KiPI and open the generated .tgz file.

Project home: https://github.com/drewsum/KiPI
